welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: Welcome to the 3Speak Shorts Editor. Let's take a quick tour of the key features.

preview.title: Preview
preview.text: This is your video preview. You can drag clips to reposition them and pinch to zoom.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: Arrange your clips here. Drag to reorder, resize the edges to trim.

addMedia.title: Add Media
addMedia.text: Tap + to add video, images, text, audio, or color clips to your tracks.

clipSettings.title: Clip Settings
clipSettings.text: Select a clip and tap the gear icon to edit its properties like scale, position, and opacity.

render.title: Render
render.text: When you're done editing, hit Render to export your video. You can then download or send it.

welcome.title: Welcome to the Audio Editor
welcome.text: Cut, clean up and level a podcast, a song or a voice note, then post it on 3Speak. Here is a quick look at what it can do.

addAudio.title: Add your audio
addAudio.text: Add a recording, record right here, or pick music from the library. Video files work too: the editor keeps only the sound. Up to 3 hours.

tracks.title: Voice and music tracks
tracks.text: Recordings go on voice tracks, music on its own track. Drag a clip to move it, pull its edges to trim. Zoom with the slider, or tap Fit to see the whole thing.

clipSettings.title: Clip settings
clipSettings.text: Select a clip to see its settings. Clean up the voice (Strong takes out noise and rumble and makes it clearer and more even), and Duck: the clip goes down while another track plays. Group voices that were recorded together to keep them in sync.

cutSilences.title: Cut silences
cutSilences.text: Finds the pauses in your voice tracks, cuts them out and closes the gaps. Grouped voices are only cut where everyone is quiet.

template.title: Your template
template.text: Set up an intro, an outro and a music bed once. They go onto every new recording, and your template is kept for good.

normalize.title: Normalize
normalize.text: Brings the export to an even podcast loudness (-16 LUFS), so every episode sounds as loud as the last. Turn it off to keep your own levels.

chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.text: Mark where each part starts (press M to add one at the playhead). Chapters go into the MP3 and into your episode's description.

export.title: Export
export.text: Export makes an MP3. Listen to it, then use it for your upload or download it. Signed in, your project is kept as a draft while you work.

intro.title: Audiograms
intro.text: Short videos of a piece of your episode: a moving waveform, your title and picture, with the 3Speak look. They go out as 3Speak Shorts together with the episode.

piece.title: Your piece
piece.text: The piece you picked on the timeline, up to 2 minutes. Change it here any time.

arrange.title: Arrange it your way
arrange.text: Drag any part to move it, pull a corner to resize it (Shift keeps the shape), and turn it with the round handle under it. The 3Speak logo always stays in, as the 3S or the full logo.

picture.title: A picture
picture.text: Upload one or take the cover of one of your playlists. It shows as a card you can move and resize like the other parts.

waveform.title: The waveform
waveform.text: Bars, lines, a circle or a circle wave, in the 3Speak red or any colour you like.

parts.title: Parts
parts.text: Hide a part, or bring it forward or send it back when parts overlap.

make.title: Make it
make.text: Make as many as you like: each goes out as a Short with the episode, with its own text and a link to it. Your last look is kept as your template for the next one.

startEnd.title: Click the start, then the end
startEnd.text: Click where the piece should start, then where it ends: up to 2 minutes. Pull its edges to adjust it, or drag across the tracks to draw a whole piece. A new click starts over.

moveAround.title: Move around
moveAround.text: Drag the ruler or scroll to move along the episode. Zoom in with the slider for a precise start, or tap Fit to see the whole episode.

listen.title: Listen to it
listen.text: Play the piece (or Space) plays just the part you picked, then goes back to its start.

use.title: Use it
use.text: Use this piece (or Enter) takes it back to your audiogram, Cancel (or Escape) keeps the old one. Until then the rest of the editor is locked, so nothing else changes by accident.
